# check_upis

> A Nagios plugin for checking UPiS power status and temperature on Raspberry Pi.

The project provides a small shell-based monitoring plugin for a UPiS UPS, an uninterruptible power supply for Raspberry Pi systems.

## Repository overview

- [Source repository](https://github.com/useidel/check_upis): Canonical GitHub repository, including source files, issues, history, and repository metadata.
- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/useidel/check_upis/HEAD/README.md): Primary project documentation and usage notes.

- Raspberry Pi
- UPiS
- UPS monitoring
